cd /workspace/tmp && cat > ttest.py <<'EOF'
import z3, time, sys, resource
n = 4000
x = z3.Int('x')
for to in (0, 20000):
    s = z3.Solver()
    if to: s.set('timeout', to)
    s.add(x >= 0, x <= 10000)
    t0 = time.time(); c0 = time.process_time()
    for i in range(n):
        s.push(); s.add(x <= 5000 + (i % 100)); s.check(); s.pop()
    print('timeout=%d: wall %.3fs cpu %.3fs  (%.1f us/check cpu)' % (
        to, time.time()-t0, time.process_time()-c0, (time.process_time()-c0)/n*1e6))
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
print('sys %.3f user %.3f' % (ru.ru_stime, ru.ru_utime))
EOF
timeout 120 python3 ttest.py
